audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1] names the spike but gives no cooldown, so the reader cannot time anything around it.
audit.why: Justice Punch is 11/10/9/8/7s. Rank-1 11s is the actual size of the window Gnar trades in.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page never mentions Colossal Smash's auto-attack reset, which is how Galio opens onto a Mini Gnar, and never gives the Justice Punch or Hop cooldown numbers.
audit.why: Galio's passive is an empowered attack with an auto-reset flag — the wind-up, not a spell cast, is the tell to step out. Gnar's Hop is 22s at rank 1, so spending it on chip leaves no answer to Justice Punch (11s at rank 1) for 11 further seconds.
audit.corrected: Colossal Smash wind-up tell added to Key Ability Interactions; Justice Punch 11s and Hop 22s written into the cooldown block, do's and don'ts.

audit.whatIsWrong: Cooldown block was generic ("your committal tool", "your ultimate") with no numbers.
audit.why: Real numbers make the window actionable.
audit.corrected: Rewritten with Justice Punch 11s and Hop 22s.

edits.before: His dash + knockup engage. Punish him when it's down. Only engage once it is down or baited.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.

edits.before: Track Galio's Justice Punch: His dash + knockup engage. Punish him when it's down. When it is down — Boomerang kite into Mega slam.
edits.after: Justice Punch (11s at rank 1) is his only gap-close; Colossal Smash's wind-up is the tell — step back on it, then Boomerang kite into Mega slam.

edits.after: - Galio Justice Punch: matchup-defining — his only gap-close, down 11s at rank 1. Track it before every engage. - Hop (E): 22s at rank 1, your only exit — never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: kill windows only.
